welcome_description: {{business}} already exists as a business. Before you enter the dashboard, let's get the minimum setup done so you can start selling.
welcome_item_account: Complete your profile and change the temporary password
welcome_item_account_desc: Document, phone and a password only you know.
welcome_item_business_desc: Legal name, tax ID and contact: this is what gets printed on invoices.
welcome_item_branch: Create your first branch and tell us its business type
welcome_item_branch_desc: Each branch can be a different business, with its own inventory and registers.
welcome_item_modules_desc: Modules are per branch: each one enables what it needs.
account_description: These details identify the person responsible for the business.
business_description: These are printed on every invoice and sent to the POS on sync.
branch_description: Each branch can be a different business, with its own inventory, prices and registers.
same_as_business_desc: Copies address, phone and email from {{business}}.
business_type_hint: Decides which modules we suggest in the next step.
branch_admin_hint: You can assign another user once you create more accounts.
modules_description: Modules are per branch. The ones marked Base cannot be turned off: the POS does not work without them.
modules_preset_hint: We preselected what is typical for {{type}}. Adjust whatever you want.
module_usuarios_desc: Who can operate at this branch.
module_inventario_desc: Stock, cost and reorder point for the branch.
module_clientes_desc: Invoice by name and keep tabs.
module_reportes_desc: Sales, voids and daily closings for the branch.
done_description: {{business}} is configured with its first branch. You can enter the dashboard and start loading your catalog.
next_register: Register the first POS terminal for {{branch}}
next_register_desc: Use one of the serial codes assigned to your business.
next_items: Load items and set their prices
next_items_desc: The catalog belongs to the business; price and stock belong to each branch.
next_branch_desc: It can be a different business type, with its own modules.
error_no_session: Session is unavailable. Please sign in again.
error_no_branch: The branch has to be created first.
